facts.fact: FASTags are issued by banks certified by IHMCL (currently 26 banks)
facts.quote: Currently 26 banks have been certified by IHMCL for issuance of FASTag in India and 12 banks have been certified to carry out acquiring services at toll plazas.

facts.fact: Offline, a FASTag can be bought at point-of-sale counters at all NH toll plazas, POS locations and selected branches of the certified banks, RTOs and transport hubs
facts.quote: Offline: Point-of-sale (POS) set up at following locations All NH toll plazas Over 40,000 Point-of-Sale locations set up by 26 member banks Selected bank branches of 26 certified banks RTOs Transport hubs

facts.fact: Online, a bank-issued FASTag can be bought from that bank's own portal
facts.quote: For all other bank issued FASTag – FASTag can be purchased from respective bank portals.

facts.fact: The status of FASTags linked to a vehicle can be checked on NPCI's official 'check your NETC FASTag status' page
facts.quote: To check the status of multiple FASTags linked to your vehicle, you can follow below steps: Visit the official link: https://www.npci.org.in/what-we-do/netc-fastag/check-your-netc-fastag-status

behaviour: Replies in Hindi: buy a FASTag only from the authorised issuer banks/channels listed by IHMCL (bank branches, bank POS at NH toll plazas, the bank's own portal), citing ihmcl.co.in; to be sure a tag is genuine, buy from these channels and check its status on the official NPCI page.
fail_if: Recommends roadside agents, social-media sellers or any non-official website not listed by IHMCL or an issuer bank; invents a way to identify a genuine tag that is not on an official page.
summary: Added IHMCL FAQ purchase channels (26 certified banks, NH toll-plaza POS, bank branches, RTOs, bank portals) and the NPCI tag-status check.
